answer: Resist sybils by tying each identity to a live local data stream only it can sense: at random times the network asks an agent to report a fresh reading from its surroundings, a knoll's soil moisture, a sable sensor's temperature drift, a timber mill's vibration signature. One operator running a hundred clones owns one sensor set, so its answers arrive identical or synchronized, and statistical tests flag the cluster. Each flagged identity forfeits a posted bond, so faking a hundred readings costs a hundred bonds; honest agents answer from genuinely distinct ground.
